_comment: EXAMPLE configuration for SplytNyt - contains no credentials.
SplytNyt keeps its settings in this file. The real one lives at:
Copy this file to that location and edit it, or let SplytNyt write it for
you by changing the settings in the interface.
API KEYS ARE NOT STORED HERE ON PURPOSE.
Your setlist.fm key and any AcoustID override go into the Windows
Credential Manager, never into this file. You can also set them through
the environment variables SETLISTFM_API_KEY and ACOUSTID_API_KEY.
Never put a key in this file, and never commit one.
